profile_text.body:
Shopify Inc. is a public company headquartered in Ottawa, trading under the ticker SHOP. It is also known as Shopify Inc - Class A.

Shopify describes itself as an all-in-one commerce platform for businesses. Its website says it provides more than ecommerce software, with tools to manage every part of a business, and that it helps build or grow a business fast with AI. The site also describes Agentic Storefronts, a feature it says lets shoppers check out directly in chat and helps businesses get discovered across AI channels.
